dedupe_keys.name: indicateurs dpef rse sncf reseau depuis 2018

description: Indicateurs DPEF (RSE) SNCF Réseau depuis 2018 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données contient l’ensemble des indicateurs clés mentionnés dans la déclaration de performance extra-financière (DPEF) de SNCF Réseau, qui chaque année, est jointe au rapport de gestion de l'entreprise. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Développement durable. Its keywords are RSE, Indicateurs , DPEF, Risques, Rapport Financier. The portal shows 2023-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
